blocks.text: Columbus's Most Trusted Window Service Contractors
Window Services in Columbus, OH
Window Services in Columbus, OH, That Cut Energy Costs and Improve Comfort

Old or damaged windows do more than look worn. They let conditioned air escape, force your HVAC system to work harder, and leave rooms near exterior walls cold in winter and hot in summer. Columbus sits in IECC Climate Zone 5, where the U.S. Department of Energy recommends windows with a U-factor of 0.30 or lower. If your home still has single-pane glass or frames from the 1990s, you are likely losing 25 to 30 percent of your heating and cooling energy through those openings.
Coldstream Exteriors helps homeowners across the 43201, 43204, 43206, 43209, 43214, 43215, 43220, and 43228 ZIP codes solve these problems with professional window services built for this climate.
Call Coldstream Exteriors at (614) 812-0811 today to schedule window services in Columbus, OH .
Why Columbus Homes Need Professional Window Services

Central Ohio weather swings from below-zero wind chills in January to humid 90-degree days in July. That range puts constant stress on window seals, frames, and glass. Homeowners in neighborhoods like Clintonville, German Village, Grandview Heights, and the Short North often notice the same warning signs before calling us:
Condensation between panes. Moisture trapped inside double-pane glass means the seal has failed. The insulating gas is gone, and the unit no longer blocks heat transfer.
Drafts near closed windows. Air leaking around frames or through cracked weatherstripping adds strain to your furnace and raises monthly bills.
Difficulty opening or closing. Warped or painted-shut frames create a safety hazard and prevent proper ventilation.
Visible frame rot or damage. Wood frames exposed to Ohio rain and snow break down over time. Left alone, the rot can spread to the surrounding wall structure.
High energy bills with no clear cause. If your HVAC system runs constantly but rooms stay uncomfortable, your windows may be the weak link in the building envelope.
Addressing these issues early protects your home's structure, lowers utility costs, and keeps every room comfortable year-round.
Our Window Service Process: Measure, Install, and Verify
Every project at Coldstream Exteriors follows a clear process so you know what to expect from the first call to the final walkthrough.
In-home assessment. A technician visits your property, measures each opening, checks the condition of existing frames, and discusses your goals for energy savings, appearance, and budget.
Product selection. We help you choose from vinyl, fiberglass, or composite frames and select glass packages with Low-E coatings, argon gas fills, and warm-edge spacers rated for Zone 5 performance.

Professional installation. Our crew removes old units, inspects the rough opening for moisture damage, installs flashing and sealant, sets the new window, and insulates the gap between the frame and framing lumber.
Final inspection and cleanup. We test every window for smooth operation, check locks and hardware, verify a tight seal, and leave your home clean.
Most single-window swaps take two to four hours. Full-house projects are typically finished within one to three days, depending on window count and accessibility.
Our Window Services in Columbus, OH
Coldstream Exteriors offers a full range of residential window services. Each one is designed to match the demands of Central Ohio's four-season climate.
Window Installation : New-construction and retrofit installations for additions, remodels, or newly built homes. We size and fit every unit to the exact rough opening.
Window Replacement : Full-frame or insert replacement for aging, damaged, or inefficient windows. We remove the old unit and install a new one that meets current energy codes.
Energy Efficient Windows : Double-pane and triple-pane glass with argon fills, Low-E coatings, and ENERGY STAR certification. Built for Columbus winters and hot summers.
Vinyl Windows : Low-maintenance, moisture-resistant frames that resist warping, peeling, and rot. A strong fit for Ohio's wet spring and fall seasons.
Bay and Bow Windows : Multi-panel units that extend outward from the wall to add space, natural light, and curb appeal to living rooms and dining areas.
Picture Windows : Fixed-pane windows that provide an unobstructed view and maximum daylight. Ideal for rooms that face a yard, garden, or tree line.
Slider Windows : Horizontal-sliding sashes that open wide for ventilation without protruding outward. A practical choice for bedrooms, kitchens, and ground-floor rooms near walkways.
Common Window Problems We Fix
Foggy or hazy glass: Failed seal between panes. The insulating gas has leaked out, and the unit needs replacement.
Sticky or jammed sashes: Swollen wood, broken balance springs, or painted tracks prevent smooth operation. We diagnose the cause and recommend repair or replacement.
Cracked or chipped glass: Even small cracks weaken the pane and reduce insulation. A full pane or unit swap restores safety and efficiency.
Water leaking around the frame: Poor flashing, deteriorated caulk, or a shifted frame allows rain to enter the wall cavity. We reseal or replace the unit and correct the drainage path.

Excessive outside noise: Single-pane or thin double-pane glass does little to block traffic, lawn equipment, or neighbor noise. Upgraded glass packages with laminated or triple-pane construction cut sound transmission.
Looking to maximize natural light in your living spaces? Explore our stunning picture windows that bring the outdoors in while maintaining excellent insulation!
